title: P@x voice settings
description: P@x's voice, in $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/tur/pax/voice.json (docs/architecture/pax-voice.md, section 6.4). Written only by tur-pax serve, on SetVoiceSettings. Every member may be missing: a missing member is its default, and a missing file is all defaults, which is voice off. The loader in services/tur-pax (voice.rs) is authoritative and also enforces: a wake word cannot be on in this version; a recognition model or a voice is a catalogue identifier of local AI's speech catalogue; a live engine is local or the identifier of an entry of the list of live engines; a provider's live engine is used only with the current consent recorded for it.

enabled.description: Whether the person switched voice on. Off by default.

language.description: The language spoken to P@x and by it: auto, or one of the offered languages.

model.description: A recognition model of local AI's speech catalogue, or null for the one local AI recommends for this computer.

voices.description: A voice per language; a language not named takes its default voice.

spoken_replies.description: Whether P@x's answers are said out loud. Off by default.

activation.description: How a turn is started. Push-to-talk is the only activation in this version.

wake_word.description: Whether a wake word is listened for. Off, and cannot be turned on in this version.

transcript_check.description: What happens to what was heard on a push-to-talk turn: show (shown, and its first change waits show_seconds) or wait (kept until the person sends it). Sound from another program always waits.

engine.description: local, or the identifier of a provider's live engine.

consent.description: The person's acceptance of a provider's live engine: its identifier, the version of the text shown, and when.
